systems.system: Décret gouvernemental n° 2021-3 du 6 janvier 2021 relatif aux données publiques ouvertes (open public data programme)
systems.owner: Unité de l'administration électronique (Prime Ministry), with a joint consultative committee under the minister for administrative modernisation
systems.tiers: All public bodies under Organic Law 2016-22 art. 2; each names an open-data officer

note: A decree on open public data after deliberation of the Council of Ministers, with no strategy behind it for the economy and the state at large; it only has the e-administration unit prepare a strategy for new open-data use cases (art. 4). No national digital strategy is named.
